title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened child protection in Sudan by deploying 152 social workers, enhancing capacity, and integrating services. It supported 6,473 unaccompanied children with case management, family reunification, and alternative care. Over 590,935 individuals accessed MHPSS services, while outreach registered 10,000 children, including 4,000 with birth certificates, despite conflict and access challenges.
